paragraphs.text: Hero is a creature type that depicts characters who, in the face of danger and adversity or from a position of weakness, display courage and the will for self-sacrifice (heroism) for some greater good.

The first creature to bear the subtype was Benalish Hero in Limited Edition Alpha , followed by Kjeldoran Warrior ( Ice Age ) and Beast Walkers ( Homelands ). Aysen Crusader ( Homelands ) was powered up by these three heroes but was not a Hero itself. The Hero-class was obsoleted in the 2007 Grand Creature Type Update and, rather than Heroes, the Crusader now gained a bonus from Soldiers and Warriors instead. Despite the policy in errata to let cards do what they are printed with, this errata remains.

The only card remaining with the subtype Hero was Fraction Jackson from Unhinged , as silver-bordered cards were allowed to have creature types not supported by the Comprehensive Rules . In 2013 , Hero was reinvented as an unofficial card type as part of the Hero's Path for the Theros block .

Hero returned as an eternal creature type in 2024 for the Universes Beyond Marvel sets. However, the type was not officially added to the Comprehensive Rules until Final Fantasy . There are currently no plans for older cards to (re)gain the creature type. As of 2025, the plan is keeping Hero and Villain more for costumed characters - that is to say, "superhero" or "supervillain" - and not for just anyone doing heroic or villainous things. The use of the Hero and Villain types is one of the major throughlines in the Marvel collaboration with Superheroes ( 882 cards ) using the type.

Hero tokens , a 1/1 creature, were first introduced in Final Fantasy to represent the franchise's party system and the player's choice of class for their characters. This is achieved largely by the Job select mechanic.
